name: Coral Springs
dining_districts: the downtown Coral Springs / Cornerstone district
the Wiles Road and Sample Road plazas
kitchen_profile: family dining rooms and chef-owned bistros
intro: Coral Springs has grown a real dining identity around its new downtown — the Cornerstone district's restaurant row — while University Drive remains one of northwest Broward's busiest restaurant miles, from chef-owned bistros to family institutions that have fed the city for decades. Country clubs, banquet halls, and one of the county's largest school communities round out the demand.

The range rewards a flexible supplier: split cases and specialty produce for downtown menus, consistent club programs with member-grade specs, and institutional case volume for school and banquet kitchens. From our Pompano Beach warehouse the run is about twenty minutes up the Sawgrass, seven days a week.
route_note: About 20 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse via the Sawgrass Expressway — downtown and University Drive stops land before lunch prep.

faqs_unique.q: Do you deliver to the new downtown Coral Springs restaurants?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. The Cornerstone district and University Drive row are daily stops on the northwest run, timed to each kitchen's receiving window.

faqs_unique.q: Can you supply country club and banquet kitchens in Coral Springs?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Club and banquet programs run standing case orders with consistent specs, plus split-case flexibility for events and seasonal menus.

cta_text: Tell us your core items, prep-heavy days, and receiving hours. We will help Coral Springs restaurants, cafes, and group dining teams keep the right produce moving into the kitchen.
